added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs: negative-control-base.log (1 failed: test_each_record_is_filed_once_not_compared_per_tree) is the base arm and head-suite.log (5 passed) is the head arm, both pytest; the after-minus-baseline set difference is 0, so the head arm adds no failing test.

0.reason: names is called only by the tests, which pass the filed record objects; no production caller relies on value equality

findings.text: follow-on: WorktreeRecordIndex.names compares its record argument to the filed records by object identity ("record is existing"), so a caller passing a value-equal but distinct record gets False where record_names_worktree returns True, contradicting the method's "by the rule's own keys" docstring; only the tests call it today, so nothing in production is wrong, but the contract misleads its next caller.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 17a0646d; the single commit d795d5aa changes three files (reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/crew/routing.py, the test file), all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py and its call-count bound; the manifest records that run and its result (5 passed in 116.00s) and the negative-control base arm (1 failed, 2 passed, 2 skipped), each in head-suite.log and negative-control-base.log.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make one call of _held_worktree_records match each record once through an index of the trees its records name; reckon/crew/obligations.py:574-582 builds a WorktreeRecordIndex and each inspected tree is one lookup, so the work is records plus trees rather than their product.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states 5 passed in 116.00s, names both gate logs, records the retry_failures and the ruff delta (-2, none added) and reads status complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/crew/routing.py and tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py, the only files the diff touches); every path in the diff is inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py:217 reddens on the base arm with "assert 10000 <= (500 + 20)", and the index-parity and whole-ledger tests at lines 230 and 262 are independent of the value under test.
justifications.evidence: the gate's count assertion at tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py:217 measures the done-when's records-plus-trees bound, but on head the count reads zero because the index never calls record_names_worktree for a named tree, and parity against the base tree is approximated by the independent whole-ledger scan in _whole_ledger_held.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:1063 keeps the new class beside record_names_worktree and shares its key derivation through _retained_worktree (line 1023) and _node_worktree_identity (line 1034); no plan label appears in the names.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:507 replaces the per-tree record walk with index.records_naming(worktree), so the delivered call matches each record once.
justifications.reuse: a search over reckon/crew found no existing owner of a record index keyed by worktree, and the new class extends the naming rule's own helpers rather than duplicating it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 17a0646d..d795d5aa touches only reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/crew/routing.py and the test file, every one inside the declared write paths.
